iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Required retrospective concept, iteration1 of max3, OpenFA Mikotaj Ylikt-shan MK1A small spacecraft. Attached image is ONLY actual paletted legacy headings, authoritative geometry. Keep two separate slender parallel tapered slate-blue metal longitudinal rails joined by a short central rectangular cross-body, with clearly open spaces between the rails in front and behind that bridge: an elongated H planform. The longitudinal rails have tapered ends, not swept crescent wings or guns. Subdued gold/brass collars at the central junctions, slate blue-grey broad metal fields, modest green details only where supported by legacy. Maintain compact small-craft scale, low overall height, simple recognizable H silhouette. Add restrained realistic material wear, edge scuffs and small seated service details, sparse seams rather than dense hull-panel grids. Do not add transparent domes, central spheres, new outriggers, cockpit bubbles or invented weapons. A single three-quarter studio product rendering with a small top view of exactly the same craft, dark neutral background, no text, no source-pixel collage.
iterations.verdict: Broad silhouette/material concept retained: separate parallel tapered rails, central cross-body, open H-shaped spaces and brass junction collars. Fine access panels are artistic interpretation, not recovered engineering.

glb_visual_review: Actual imported GLB inspected against legacy and the concept: H-shaped open planform, two blue-slate rails and central bridge/collars agree. Existing rounded rail sections and central faceting are retained where the small legacy frames do not resolve cross sections. No new weapons or hidden mechanisms inferred.
